name: gateway
description: Cloudflare Worker at https://your-worker.example.workers.dev that holds the GroupMe and Twilio secrets so cloud routines need only one key.

scripts.deploy: npm run build && node scripts/cf-token.mjs run npx wrangler deploy
scripts.check: npm run test && npm run build && node scripts/cf-token.mjs run npx wrangler deploy --dry-run
scripts.migrate: node scripts/cf-token.mjs run npx wrangler d1 migrations apply jarvis-assistant --remote
